rationale: The inline success shape is extracted as AuthorizationPermissionCreateResponse so the response has a stable named schema without changing its fields.

slug.description: A unique key to reference the permission. Must be lowercase and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, colons, periods, and asterisks.

name.description: A descriptive name for the Permission.

description.description: An optional description of the Permission.

system.description: Whether the permission is a system permission. System permissions are managed by WorkOS and cannot be deleted.

resource_type_slug.description: The slug of the resource type associated with the permission.

provenance.observed: The operation declares its AuthorizationPermissionCreateResponse success shape inline at /paths/~1authorization~1permissions/post/responses/201/content/application~1json/schema.
provenance.specd: The SDK exposes the same success shape through the named AuthorizationPermissionCreateResponse component.
